items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ben Riley might have been who it was.

ctx.x: Ben Riley played with Monk for years, but that began in 1964...
Ben Riley might have been who it was.
So you start to tour a bit in 1959 and 1960, and people know who you are because the recordings are coming out. I’m interested in how your career started to coalesce.
